newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech share slide continues on Prague bourse.
newsitem.headline: Czech share slide continues on Prague bourse.

text.p: Czech shares fell for the fourth consecutive session on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday, as foreign investors remain noticeably absent from trading.
Four of the PSE's five most capitalised issues all lost ground, pushing the Reuters RPIX index down 7.4 points to 1,119.9, while the broader PX50 index eased 4.6 points to 538.6.
One of the hardest hit blue chips on the day was engineering concern Skoda, which fell 52 crowns to 846. Komercni Banka lost 30 crowns to close at 2,300.

"Foreign investors are just waiting out the current slide, and once the bourse loses another few percent, we may see them step in and halt the trend, at least for a short period," said one local trader.
Overall volume was heavier at 2.77 million shares, though a mere 163,003 shares were traded on the automated floor. Turnover was 1.3 billion crowns.
